text: Stop using ChatGPT for every single task. Every major AI has evolved into a completely different specialist.

Need fast brainstorming, voice mode, or everyday help? Use ChatGPT. Writing long documents or building real software? Claude is sharper and sounds more human. Analyzing full videos, audio, or massive PDFs inside Google apps? That is Gemini's superpower.
And when you hit tough logic puzzles, switch on a Thinking mode so the AI double-checks its own work—or run open-weight models like DeepSeek locally for free.
